ai_summary_zh: 本場區道路與人行步道鋪面狀況良好，主要為瀝青混凝土鋪設。場區內共有22棵喬木，平均胸徑為33.2公分，並設有27處擋土牆或建築牆體結構。場區內無水域。
ai_summary_en: The paved road and walkway corridor is in good condition, primarily consisting of asphalt concrete surfaces. The site features 22 urban trees with a mean DBH of 33.2 cm at 1.3m, alongside 27 retaining or building wall structures. There are no water bodies on site.
